attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared writable directory with the sticky bit (mode 1777, owned root:root), verified users can create files but cannot delete or overwrite files owned by other users. Completed mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, restarted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified /srv/drop's permissions and sticky-bit behavior after reboot.
